notes.title: Version 1.3.4
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where you sometimes couldn't change keyboard rebindings after opening the Steam overlay
- Made it easier to put the wooden sword on fire
- Made it possible to button rebind other movements (flying, golfing etc.)
- Rebind translations

notes.title: Version 1.3.3
notes.notes:
You can now rebind movements too, including driving controls. So if you e.g. prefer accelerating with W and doing tricks with the arrow keys, it's an easy adjustments.

Also, the button prompts are now updated after adjusting rebindings.

notes.title: Control rebinding
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943800/5fbf51e98a9e8c1838fa7bfb5813a2bfecf3fc6d.png[/img]

I know that many of you have been asking for this feature for a long time and I was planning to include it in the first release, but there's some complexity connected to it with all the different activities. Anyway, rebinding of controls is now possible! I still recommend using the default controls, but the feature is obviously here to stay so you are welcome to give me feedback on how I can improve it.

I also have watched the Brazilian streamer Lude (yes, almost like the game) lately, which has given me ideas for other things that need to be fixed.

Version 1.3.0
- Control rebinding added

Version 1.3.1
- Control rebinding translations
- Fixed a couple of Portuguese translation errors
- Menu windows are no longer slightly too high for ultra-wide screens

Version 1.3.2
- Lock the cursor to the game window, except for when the game is paused (useful if you have two screens)
- More ultra-wide screen compability fixes
- Fixed issues with a few sound clips that weren't affected by volume settings
- Fixed issue with the select card game menu
- There's no longer possible to set the quality level to 0 by pressing a key
- A couple of more minor fixes

notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
- In case you have problems with controller stick drifting, you can now configure stick deadzones in the general settings
- Replaced the Unity icon with a Ludde icon
- Made it easier to understand the map indicators for the treasure hunts
- Added a separate leaderboard for easy mode in the fly through wings challenge and removed the separate leaderboards for a couple of purple coins challenges
- Added white birds
- More snowmobiles to be found
- A few more small fixes

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Includes some small fixes and improvements.

- Fixed issue where snowball battle opponents were getting stuck
- The sky/clouds are now moving again
- Hide obstacle in mini golf when it's blocking the camera
- Indicators in the hockey minigame are now easier to see
- Show the Santa hat while celebrating a golden dog bone
- Fixed issue where objects were obstructing the descending spikes in the closed small fort 
- Don't hit the ground in the whack moles minigame
- More arrow signs in races and reduced time
- Dialogue updates
- A few more fixes

notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943800/8a1f8554f9e25c15bcdc6335d0a88292c990799d.png[/img]

Ludde wishes you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! To celebrate this, Ludde now can wear a Santa hat and ignite fireworks. Unlike other dogs, the bangs don't scare him.

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7HbNZyPqscI

Other than that, I've watched like 30 hours of Ludde gameplay on Youtube and Twitch during the week, which has given me great insights into what needs to be improved. Thanks to AchievementHuntersAnon, ToughGamingGuy, EmotionalSupportOtter, and others!

- Added indicators to make it clearer what you are supposed to do in hockey, mogul skiing, biathlon, and the boss fight
- Made it clearer what to do in the laser glass house, and don't trigger the alarm as easily e.g. when standing on windows
- Added another way to get into the closed small fort
- Ludde now can pick up snowballs, even if he's standing close to the sacks in the target practice minigame 
- Fixed minor dungeon graphical issues (Steam Deck)
- Smoothed the terrain in the slide conditions minigame
- A few bug fixes
- Lots of other minor improvements

notes.title: Version 1.1.6
notes.notes:
We can call this the "Otter update" since a lot of it is fixes of feedback I got from EmotionalSupportOtter when he live-streamed Ludde last week. I've also got very good feedback from other players like ToughGamingGuy via e-mail. Thank you very much!

- Ludde now runs faster
- The game won't be unfocused anymore if the user is primarily using a gamepad but clicks outside the screen. In other words, the camera control will still work.
- Fairies won't disturb you if you are busy with an activity
- Fixed exploit in the touch snowballs before they land minigame
- Made two minigolf holes easier
- Increased jigsaw puzzle table size
- You can now match jigsaw puzzle pieces even if they are rotated incorrectly
- Made it easier to dump all snow by holding the button
- Higher ramp in the ski tricks game
- Improved the AI in the memory game
- Simplified resolution settings
- Added more fire sources you can ignite your wooden sword with
- Added more coins out in the wilderness
- Fixed issue with the "Impatient" achievement
- Lots of other small fixes

notes.title: Wearable backpack
notes.notes:
This is the first update with a new feauture. You can now wear a backpack and more wearable items might be included in future updates. You find it in Ludde's house. 

Other than that, there are some big improvments players have asked for.

- You can now double jump when running off ledges (previously you could only do one jump in those cases)
- Wearable backback
- When playing hockey, the aim arrow now rotates vertically too
- Skis now have better grip
- Fixed issue where rollable snowballs sometimes disappeared
- Specific music for some dungeons
- When you start a new game, you now get 5 coins to get you started
- More birds
- Removed the fur option from graphics options menu, it's just too ugly when turned off
- Lots of minor fixes and improvments

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943800/78ee43d4e51e8500f102899237b393b8cff9d5a1.png[/img]

Let me know if there are anything you wish for in the next update.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
- If you feel like the camera rotation is too choppy, now you can make it smoother by adjusting camera smoothing in the graphics options window. I recommend setting it to 3.
- Various minor fixes.

notes.title: First patch released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943800/f0726e80715feb338811011d49d37c04b379a2a1.png[/img]

To improve the user experience, the following changes have been made:
- Improved controls for cross-country skiing using keyboard and mouse
- Made it easier to fill snow cannons with snow
- Added birds, more of them will be added in future updates
- Removed the water reflections graphics option due to performance issues
- Made it possible to be excluded from online leaderboard
- Various minor fixes

notes.title: Ludde - Live Stream
notes.notes: Ludde is finally here! Join me while I explore Ludde's world and collect golden dog bones.

notes.title: Launch trailer released
notes.notes:
We're getting really close to release now! I just updated the game to version 1.0.0, which in other words means that the game is release ready. This Friday (December 1) you can play around with snow, collect stuff, break new records in minigames, and explore the beautiful winter environment while riding (or flying!) a snowmobile.

The lauch trailer has just been uploaded to the Steam page and Youtube, check it out!

There's so much more I'd like to show you since there really is a ton of content in this game, but the trailer can't be too long either. Stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=bCXc8ScrfkY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Portuguese and German translations added!
notes.notes:
The demo has been out for a couple of weeks, since Steam Next Fest October, and I'm very happy to see that many people have downloaded and played the game. As advertised previously the game will be fully translated into Brazilian Portuguese and it has now been implemented, but there is also another all-new translation. The demo can now also be played in German.

To celebrate this I've raised both country flags in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943800/23e581ff1be5688afee03c022e4d6e790d3a2b5e.png[/img]

Many thanks to [b]Thiago dos Santos Mania[/b] who has been very dedicated, and professional and he really went out of his way for quality assurance while working with the Portuguese translation.

The demo now also supports Steam Leaderboards, which means that you can compare your minigame scores to the Steam Community. I bet you can't beat my highscores.
